solutions.latex:
After 3rd recharge it will be 90% of 16 hrs.
$$= 16 \times 0.90$$
$$= 14.4 \text{ hrs}$$

$$S_\infty = \frac{a}{1-r} = \frac{14.4}{1 - 0.9} = 144 \text{ hrs}$$
The battery will last
$$= 25 + 20 + 16 + 144$$
$$= 205 \text{ hours}$$

$T_n < 1$, $n = ?$
$$14.4 \times 0.9^{n-1} < 1$$
$$0.9^{n-1} < \frac{1}{14.4}$$
Taking log on both sides
$$(n-1)\log 0.9 < \log(1/14.4)$$
$$n - 1 > \frac{\log(1/14.4)}{\log 0.9}$$
$$n > 25.3152 + 1$$
$$n > 26.3152$$
$$n = 27 + 2 \text{ previous charges}$$
$$n = 29$$
$\therefore$ The power is less than 1 hour after $29^{\text{th}}$ charge.
